sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The alate is closest to A. dentosus and A. darwini; it is distinctly larger than typical individuals of the former and has 1 more antennal segment, and is slightly larger than the latter and usually has 1 more antennal segment. The soldier is smaller and darker than that of A. darwini, with shorter and relatively stouter mandibles.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Closest to A. dentosus and A. darwini (see the comparisons under those species). Measurements (type colony): length with wings 12.75—14.00 mm, length without wings 6.60—8.00 mm, head length (to apex of labrum) 1.50—1.70 mm, head length (to clypeofrontal suture) 0.73—0.84 mm, head width 1.34—1.40 mm, greatest diameter of compound eye 0.33 mm, ocellus length 0.11—0.14 mm, pronotum length 0.66—0.73 mm, width 1.23—1.36 mm, forewing length 10.75—11.25 mm, width 3.00—3.30 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Variable species, head dark orange. Sides of the head slightly rounded, the posterior part broadly rounded. Mandibles usually moderately short and stout, distinctly shorter than the head capsule; the mandibular tooth slightly nearer the base than the apex, not distinctly hook-shaped (in some series from Queensland the mandibles of all or some individuals are narrower). Antennae 15-segmented; segment 3 smallest. Measurements (type colony): total length 4.50—4.60 mm, head length (including mandibles) 2.18—2.25 mm, head length (to clypeofrontal suture) 1.06—1.28 mm, head length (to apex of labrum) 1.58—1.72 mm, head width 1.10—1.18 mm, postmentum width 0.29—0.33 mm, pronotum length 0.36—0.44 mm, width 0.73—0.81 mm.

note: Adapted from the species-level description in Hill (1942), originally in English; the original describes the alate and the soldier, the worker being listed only as a morphotype without description. The original measurements form a three- to four-column table (type colony, a single specimen from Roper River, N.T., Homestead, Q., and the soldier table has in addition a small series 3.25—4.00 mm); this entry takes only the type colony column. The table is severely misaligned by row and column in the OCR (for example, the head-width row "1.34 I*4o I*37 1*43 1.21" is read as three columns 1.34—1.40 / 1.37—1.43 / 1.21), and the remaining columns are not recorded, pending verification. OCR also: the genus name appears as Hcmitermes, the synonymy line as Hmitermes; "Porewing" is Forewing; "sth" is 5th. Distribution and biology are not translated into the morphology section.
